verdict.rationale: Publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a SaaS compliance service like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no llms.txt or agent-facing docs. The main host answers even robots.txt with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) to a keyless agent. The legacy CT host's permissive robots.txt only 301-redirects its content into that walled host, so an agent cannot reach any CT Corporation documentation.
